thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — P1: Usage emission backlog detected. A subset of usage events delayed ~12-45m. Symptoms: delayed token counts, transient overage flags for some customers. Link: https://dash.redwood/in/usage-emit

alex: seeing same, alerts spiking in wavefront, emitter queue depth up 3x :rotating_light:

maria: oncall here, joining huddle. Has customer-facing impact? @finance-ops can you confirm?

finance-ops: small set (~12 customers) received overage flags; flags only, no billing charges yet. Holding notifications until recon.

sre-ops: looking at emit-fanout-v2 — recent config bump increased fanout concurrency. Workers hit a GC pause pattern under heavy KV-cache warmups. Autoscaler tried to spin but pods kept flapping.

alex: I'm rolling the previous config now: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/emit-fanout-v2 --to-revision=3`

ingest-oncall: rollback started, new pods terminating, old pods coming up. queue depth: 18.2k -> 12.1k (2m)

maria: adding eng-sre and customer-success to channel. @june please draft a customer note if we need to notify affected accounts.

june: draft ready, will hold until we have reconciliation numbers: "We observed delayed usage reporting affecting a subset of customers. No charges will be applied while we reconcile historical events."

billing-eng: running quick reconcile for 02:10-02:50 UTC window to compare emitted vs ingested counts:
```
SELECT customer_id, sum(emitted_tokens) as emitted, sum(ingested_tokens) as ingested
FROM usage_views
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-16T02:10:00Z' AND '2026-03-16T02:50:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY emitted - ingested DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Prelim: ~0.2-0.6% undercount on emitter side for ~8 customers, rest within margin.

finance-ops: marking those 8 as "pending-recon" in billing dashboard. No automated notifications. We'll prepare credit/adjustment plan if diffs persist.

sre-ops: mitigation sequence: 1) rollback config (done) 2) bump scale target + transient burst nodes 3) apply GC tuning patch to image and re-deploy in canary. Monitoring backlog.

alex: backlog trending: 18.2k -> 4.7k in 6m after rollback and scale. No new overage flags triggered since rollback. :white_check_mark:

ingest-oncall: backlog now 680. Worker error rate normalized. Emitted->ingested diffs shrinking in sampling queries.

maria: keeping incident open for reconciliation and customer comms. Handoff: I'll hand to @alex for monitoring and postmortem write-up at 03:05 UTC.

june: will prepare the post-ack customer message and run it by @finance-ops and @billing-eng before sending.

billing-eng: queued a targeted backfill job for the 8 affected customers if we confirm missing events; will only run after ops sign-off.

finance-ops: confirming no charges will be finalized until backfill completes and diffs are validated.

incident-bot: Incident #4422109876 status update -> mitigated: true, owner=alex, severity=P1 -> P2 (recon). Next steps: postmortem + customer reconciliation.

alex: noted. I'll keep a 30m watch, then close after reconciliation. Thanks everyone.

ingest-oncall: last update: backlog emptying, final sample diffs <0.1%. Recommend close in 25m unless anomalies reappear.
